default_rule: A sector match triggers screening, not a compliance conclusion. Verify jurisdiction, activity, scale, site and competent authority before modelling cost or timing.

gates.question: Does the activity move, breed, process or export plants, animals, seed, feed or biological material?
gates.evidence: Product and movement map; current permits and competent-authority determination
gates.model_impact: Permit, inspection, quarantine, testing, loss and lead-time assumptions
gates.stop_condition: Do not model commercial launch or cross-border volume until applicability and lead time are evidenced

gates.question: Could land use, water abstraction, waste, chemicals or habitat effects trigger environmental review?
gates.evidence: Site/activity screen and authority response
gates.model_impact: Site preparation, mitigation, monitoring and contingency
gates.stop_condition: Do not commit an affected site or implementation date before screening

gates.question: Is a product standard, hygiene control, label review, testing or certification required?
gates.evidence: SKU register, process flow and current product-specific authority determination
gates.model_impact: Laboratory, certification, packaging, rejects and release lead time
gates.stop_condition: Do not forecast sale of an unassessed regulated SKU

gates.question: Do effluent, emissions, by-products or waste require controls or approval?
gates.evidence: Waste map, site screen and current authority requirements
gates.model_impact: Treatment capex, operating cost and commissioning gates
gates.stop_condition: Do not approve plant design without the waste-control basis

gates.question: Does the offering constitute a health facility, professional practice, medicine, device, laboratory or health-data service?
gates.evidence: Service/product classification and written competent-authority route
gates.model_impact: Premises, professional staffing, registration, pharmacovigilance and renewal cost
gates.stop_condition: Do not claim approval, efficacy or launch readiness before classification and required approval

gates.question: Are health, safety, diagnostic or therapeutic claims made?
gates.evidence: Claims inventory and substantiation review
gates.model_impact: Testing, insurance, recall and legal review
gates.stop_condition: Remove or qualify an unsupported claim

gates.question: Does the provider issue a regulated qualification, operate an institution or market accredited training?
gates.evidence: Programme, award and provider classification with authority confirmation
gates.model_impact: Accreditation sequence, faculty, facilities and intake timing
gates.stop_condition: Do not advertise an unverified accredited award or enrolment date

gates.question: Will the activity serve children or vulnerable learners?
gates.evidence: Safeguarding, consent, incident and data-control design
gates.model_impact: Staff checks, training, supervision and insurance
gates.stop_condition: Do not start delivery without approved safeguarding controls

gates.question: Does the model receive, hold, transmit, lend, insure, exchange or advise on customer money?
gates.evidence: End-to-end money flow and written regulatory-perimeter assessment
gates.model_impact: Licence capital, safeguarding, compliance staff, settlement and reserves
gates.stop_condition: Do not launch or describe the activity as licensed before authority confirmation

gates.question: Do customer funds, credit decisions or regulated records require reconciliations and audit trails?
gates.evidence: Control matrix, ledger ownership, reconciliation and exception evidence
gates.model_impact: Systems, operations staffing, losses, assurance and close
gates.stop_condition: Do not release a model whose money flow does not reconcile

gates.question: Does the service provide communications, spectrum, broadcasting, postal or other regulated infrastructure?
gates.evidence: Service architecture and current licence-class determination
gates.model_impact: Licence, spectrum, equipment, security and rollout lead time
gates.stop_condition: Do not model unrestricted rollout before the perimeter is confirmed

gates.question: Are personal, financial, health or cross-border data processed?
gates.evidence: Data-flow map, lawful-basis review, retention and incident controls
gates.model_impact: Security, hosting, consent, support and incident response
gates.stop_condition: Do not release a plan that leaves a material data flow unassessed

gates.question: Does the operation require tourism, accommodation, food, event or local trading approval?
gates.evidence: Service/site classification and current national/local approval map
gates.model_impact: Premises, inspection, insurance and opening sequence
gates.stop_condition: Do not publish an opening date before critical approvals are sequenced

gates.question: Could the site affect protected areas, waste systems, water or local communities?
gates.evidence: Site and stakeholder screen
gates.model_impact: Mitigation, community engagement, seasonality and contingency
gates.stop_condition: Do not commit the site before environmental screening

gates.question: Are exploration, extraction, mineral trading, generation or energy infrastructure rights required?
gates.evidence: Resource, land, licence and beneficial-ownership diligence
gates.model_impact: Licence sequence, exploration risk, closure security and royalties/tax review
gates.stop_condition: Do not value unverified rights as controlled assets

gates.question: Does the project require environmental and social assessment, resettlement, closure or rehabilitation controls?
gates.evidence: Current project classification and approved study route
gates.model_impact: Studies, mitigation, community commitments, closure and schedule
gates.stop_condition: Do not approve construction or production timing before the environmental route is evidenced

gates.question: Do land, planning, building, fire, occupational or environmental approvals control site use?
gates.evidence: Title/lease diligence, design basis and approval matrix
gates.model_impact: Design, permits, utilities, commissioning and delay contingency
gates.stop_condition: Do not start procurement against an unverified site and approval path

gates.question: Are machinery, inputs or outputs subject to compulsory standards, testing or import controls?
gates.evidence: Equipment/SKU register and conformity route
gates.model_impact: Certification, customs, rejects, maintenance and spares
gates.stop_condition: Do not forecast full output before critical equipment and product clearance

gates.question: Are traded goods restricted, standardised, age-controlled, imported or subject to special tax treatment?
gates.evidence: SKU, origin, customs and product-control register
gates.model_impact: Landed cost, tax, clearance, returns and inventory lead time
gates.stop_condition: Do not price or order an unassessed controlled SKU

gates.question: Do selling, payments, promotions, returns or customer-data practices create consumer or data obligations?
gates.evidence: Customer journey, terms, returns, payment and data-flow review
gates.model_impact: Refunds, chargebacks, support, security and retention
gates.stop_condition: Do not release unsupported price, guarantee or delivery claims

gates.question: Are vehicle, operator, route, warehousing, aviation, maritime or dangerous-goods approvals required?
gates.evidence: Asset, route, cargo and operator classification
gates.model_impact: Fleet standard, insurance, permits, maintenance and route constraints
gates.stop_condition: Do not model a route or cargo service before operating requirements are confirmed

gates.question: Does the flow cross borders or create bonded, customs, excise or tax obligations?
gates.evidence: Incoterm, tariff, origin, agent and border-process evidence
gates.model_impact: Landed cost, working capital, delay and compliance staffing
gates.stop_condition: Do not quote cross-border margin without a reconciled landed-cost route

gates.question: Is entity, geography, activity, procurement or co-financing eligibility evidenced?
gates.evidence: Call text, entity documents and signed eligibility checklist
gates.model_impact: Allowable budget, indirect cost, match funding and implementation start
gates.stop_condition: Do not submit or recognise restricted funding with an unresolved eligibility blocker

gates.question: Are restricted funds, safeguarding, procurement, reporting and audit obligations designed?
gates.evidence: Grant conditions, fund-accounting map, procurement and safeguarding controls
gates.model_impact: Restricted cash, reporting staff, audit, disallowance and sustainability
gates.stop_condition: Do not call the budget compliant before donor and finance review
